notes: rosidl_generator_py is a code generator: both api elements are class attributes emitted by the EmPy template resource/_msg.py.em into every generated message class (included for messages, service request/response/event and action messages via resource/_idl.py.em:30-67). __slots__ (lines 205-213) lists '_' + member.name for each member (skipping the sole placeholder member of an empty structure) followed by '_check_fields' (line 212). _fields_and_field_types (lines 215-256) maps member.name to a type string ('sequence<...>', 'T[N]', 'string<N>', 'pkg/Type' using namespaces[0]) and has no '_check_fields' entry; get_fields_and_field_types() returns a copy (lines 413-416). '_check_fields' is set in __init__ from the 'check_fields' kwarg or the module-level ros_python_check_fields read from env ROS_PYTHON_CHECK_FIELDS (resource/_idl.py.em:10; _msg.py.em:296-304). The three msg elements are definitions owned by other packages; this snapshot neither defines nor references them and none of its definitions or code depend on them, so no dependency definition files were fetched and no definition_id is recorded.
